title: MODIS/Terra NDVI 250 m (MOD13Q1 v061)
fetched: 75/75 requests (73 x 113 pixels around the pilot centre), 575 composites
credit: Didan, K. (2021). MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 250m SIN Grid V061. NASA EOSDIS LP DAAC. Subsets from ORNL DAAC (2018), MODIS and VIIRS Land Products Global Subsetting and Visualization Tool.
message: 8,050 field-composites, 575 dates; 0 request(s) missing; sanity passed
notes: A 50 ha pivot holds only ~9 MODIS pixels and its edge pixels mix in desert, so MODIS NDVI reads lower than Landsat. The pixel-reliability band was not fetched (it would double the requests to a slow service); the app therefore uses only each year's peak-season maximum, which is robust to cloud and snow.
